response.sql: WITH winners AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id), hand_counts AS (SELECT batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_count FROM winners GROUP BY batting_hand), shares AS (SELECT batting_hand, player_count, CAST(player_count AS REAL) / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), hand_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.batting_hand, s.player_count, s.share, s.share - h.average_share AS above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN hand_average AS h WHERE s.share > h.average_share;

assumptions.assumption: NULL, empty, and whitespace-only batting-hand values form one group, displayed as an empty string.
